page_title: EIN 2-0 FRE | Eintracht Frankfurt v Freiburg 01/03/2026, Stats - Flashscore.com | Match

commentary.text: 90+5' The referee blows for the end of today's match.
90+2' Freiburg can’t profit from the corner as the defence clear the ball upfield.
90' 4 min. of stoppage-time to be played.
87' Cyriaque Irie (Freiburg) makes a bad challenge on his opponent and is booked by the referee.
86' Derry Scherhant (Freiburg) aims for the middle of the goal, but that's an easy job for the goalkeeper. It will take more than that to test him!
86' Nnamdi Collins (Eintracht Frankfurt) is booked after bringing down an opponent. Christian Dingert had an easy-decision to make.
85' Eintracht Frankfurt are dominating the game at the moment by exchanging a combination of one or two touch passes. Great harmony between the players.
83' The shots on goal statistics – 5:1.
81' 2 - 0 Jean-Matteo Bahoya (Eintracht Frankfurt) latched on to a sweet pass and coolly slotted the ball inside the right post.
80' The referee stops play so that a substitution can be made and Nicolas Hofler (Freiburg) replaces Patrick Osterhage.
78' Derry Scherhant (Freiburg) launches the ball from the resulting corner, but one of the defenders is first to the ball and deals with the threat.
77' Albert Riera has decided to make a change. Ellyes Skhiri (Eintracht Frankfurt) replaces Hugo Larsson.
77' Here's the change. Jonathan Burkardt leaves the pitch and Ayoube Amaimouni (Eintracht Frankfurt) comes on as a substitute.
75' Jonathan Burkardt (Eintracht Frankfurt) should know this behaviour is beyond the rules. He was too careless with his challenge and left Christian Dingert no option but to blow his whistle.
72' Substitution. Cyriaque Irie (Freiburg) has come on for Lucas Holer.
72' Julian Schuster has decided to substitute Vincenzo Grifo and he is replaced by Derry Scherhant (Freiburg).
71' Freiburg have a chance to score from a corner kick, but the ball is cleared by a defender.
70' The ball is cleared after Bruno Ogbus (Freiburg) attempted to dribble past an opposing player.
68' The current number of shots on target for both teams is 8:2.
66' Lucas Holer (Freiburg) is lucky to receive a yellow card from the referee because he could easily have been given a red card for his foul.
64' 1 - 0 Fares Chaibi (Eintracht Frankfurt) has acres of space after latching on to a precise pass into the box. He doesn't hesitate to release a low effort which ends up in the bottom right corner.
64' Albert Riera prepares a substitution. Oscar Hojlund is replaced by Fares Chaibi (Eintracht Frankfurt).
63' Substitution. Ritsu Doan (Eintracht Frankfurt) on for Mario Gotze.
63' Mario Gotze (Eintracht Frankfurt) rolls the ball short to a teammate from the corner instead of sending a cross into the box.

62' Jean-Matteo Bahoya (Eintracht Frankfurt) produces a lovely ball into the penalty area but the defender manages to intercept and comfortably averts the danger. The ball is out of play. Eintracht Frankfurt win a corner kick.
60' One of the defenders reacts at the last minute to brilliantly block a pass from Jean-Matteo Bahoya (Eintracht Frankfurt).
58' Some neat passing and movement from Eintracht Frankfurt as they ping around some short passes in order to create a new attacking opportunity.
56' 60:40 – the latest ball possession ratio.
54' Arnaud Kalimuendo (Eintracht Frankfurt) blasts the ball from just outside the box, but his attempt is blocked by the defender.
52' Christian Gunter (Freiburg) sends a beautiful cross into the penalty area, but the opposition's defence manages to clear the ball to safety.
50' A good clearance by a defender means the corner comes to nothing for Freiburg.
49' Eintracht Frankfurt quickly take a corner kick with a short pass.
48' Matthias Ginter (Freiburg) pulls the jersey of one of the opposition players and Christian Dingert blows his whistle for a foul.
46' The players are back out on the pitch following the half-time break and the second half is about to start.
45+5' Christian Dingert has ended the first half by blowing the whistle.
45+2' Igor Matanovic (Freiburg) connects with a cross from out wide in the six-yard box, but only plants his header onto the right post.
45' We will have 4 min. of added time.
44' Dangerous play by Hugo Larsson (Eintracht Frankfurt). Christian Dingert blows his whistle for a foul.
41' Jean-Matteo Bahoya (Eintracht Frankfurt) plays in a hopeful cross, but it doesn't find its way to any of the attacking players.
39' 4:0 – this is the total number of shots produced by both teams.
37' Eintracht Frankfurt are bossing possession of the ball and make numerous short passes, but they finally lose possession after an error.
34' A long cross from the side is directed to the well-positioned Christian Gunter (Freiburg), but the defence gets it clear.

32' Mario Gotze (Eintracht Frankfurt) takes the resulting free kick from outside the box. He sends a nice cross into the box, but his intention is well anticipated by the goalkeeper who comes out to collect the ball.
29' Arnaud Kalimuendo (Eintracht Frankfurt) zig-zags his way into the box and drills a low shot towards the middle of the goal, but the goalkeeper makes a great reaction save to stop the effort.
28' Some great controlled play and passing from Eintracht Frankfurt. They are increasing their possession of the ball and trying to open up the opposition's defence to hit them swiftly on the break.
26' Let's have a look at statistics for the fouls committed by both teams – 1:3.
24' Jonathan Burkardt (Eintracht Frankfurt) picks up a rebound inside the penalty area and drills a shot to the middle of the goal, but is denied by a reflex save from Noah Atubolu.
24' Nathaniel Brown (Eintracht Frankfurt) aims a low effort to the middle of the goal, but the goalkeeper makes a comfortable save.
23' A raking crossfield pass from Noah Atubolu (Freiburg) lacks accuracy and the opposition gain possession.
21' Arnaud Kalimuendo (Eintracht Frankfurt) found some space to dink a cross from the side into the box, but it needed to be more precise to threaten the opposition.
19' Christian Gunter (Freiburg) puts a dangerous cross into the box, but the corner is cleared by the first man.

18' Yuito Suzuki (Freiburg) attempts to find his teammate with a pass from outside the box, but the opposition's defence is quick to react and thwarts the attack. The referee points to the corner flag. It's a corner to Freiburg.
16' Eintracht Frankfurt are happy showing off their ball keeping skills and that is only interrupted when the defender steps in.
14' The ball possession at the moment is 53:47.
12' Eintracht Frankfurt take the corner, but their hopes of scoring a goal end with a nice clearance by the defence.
12' Arnaud Kalimuendo (Eintracht Frankfurt) latches on to a pin-point through ball, but one of the defending players dispossess him. Brilliant defending. Eintracht Frankfurt win a corner.
10' A corner kick by Freiburg is thwarted by the well prepared Michael Zetterer (Eintracht Frankfurt).
9' Bruno Ogbus (Freiburg) skips past his man but can't keep the ball in play.
7' Christian Gunter (Freiburg) attempts to send a pass but the effort is blocked.
5' Albert Riera is forced to make an unplanned substitution as Kaua Santos (Eintracht Frankfurt) suffers an injury and Michael Zetterer comes on.
2' The game is interrupted now, Kaua Santos (Eintracht Frankfurt) picks up a knock and the physio has to come on.
1' The first half of this match is about to start.
The players are out at last! Eintracht Frankfurt will take the kick-off.
Today's referee will be Christian Dingert.
